name: hubspot
description: HubSpot CRM integration via the CRM v3 API — search and read contacts, companies, deals, and tickets, list pipelines and owners, create and update CRM records, and log notes on records. Authenticates with a HubSpot private-app access token (Bearer) against api.hubapi.com.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: HubSpot CRM records via the CRM v3 API (private-app token)

fields.label: Private App Access Token
fields.helpText: Access token of a HubSpot private app (Settings > Development > Legacy apps > Create private app) with the CRM scopes this skill needs.

tools.name: hubspot.search_objects
tools.description: Search CRM records (contacts, companies, deals, or tickets) by a single property filter and/or free-text query. Returns trimmed results plus a nextAfter cursor for paging. Note: HubSpot caps search at ~5 requests/second per token and 10,000 total results per query.

query.description: Free-text search across the object's default searchable properties

propertyName.description: Property to filter on (e.g. email, dealstage, hs_pipeline)

operator.description: Filter operator (default EQ), e.g. EQ, NEQ, GT, GTE, LT, LTE, CONTAINS_TOKEN, HAS_PROPERTY

properties.description: Property names to return for each record

after.description: Paging cursor from a previous result's nextAfter

tools.name: hubspot.get_object
tools.description: Get a single CRM record by id, optionally selecting properties and including associated record ids.

associations.description: Object types to return associated record ids for (e.g. contacts, deals)

tools.name: hubspot.list_pipelines
tools.description: List pipelines (with their stages: id, label, displayOrder) for deals or tickets.

tools.name: hubspot.list_owners
tools.description: List CRM owners (users records can be assigned to): id, email, first and last name.

tools.name: hubspot.create_object
tools.description: Create a CRM record (contact, company, deal, or ticket) with the given properties.

tools.name: hubspot.update_object
tools.description: Update properties of an existing CRM record.

properties.description: Property name -> value map of fields to change

tools.name: hubspot.add_note
tools.description: Log a note on a CRM record (contact, company, deal, or ticket). hs_timestamp is required by HubSpot, so pass the note time as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

objectType.description: Type of the record to attach the note to

objectId.description: Id of the record to attach the note to

timestamp.description: Note timestamp (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-07-18T12:00:00Z) — required by HubSpot's hs_timestamp property
